messages:
Maria (AE): FYI Acme Health sent an order form + redlines. They want split invoicing (US + UK) and net60 for the POC. Need legal + finance to confirm signer lanes and whether we need per-entity envelopes. cc @Raj (SalesOps)

Raj (SalesOps): do we have the exact entity legal names and VAT? Also any KMS/HSM reqs in the redline?

Maria (AE): Names: 'Acme Health Global, Inc.' (US), 'Acme Health UK Ltd.' (GB). VAT: GB999888777. No HSM, they asked to mention KMS key rotation in DPA. I'll upload redline when they share.

contracts-bot: New file uploaded: acme_orderform_redline_2026.pdf

Elaine (Legal): thanks. primary checklist: subprocessors enumerated in DPA? SLA tweaks? who is signing MSA vs orderform? standard routing we prefer: MSA -> customer GC ; Orderform/PO -> customer AP. We need a fallback signer if GC delegates.

Tomas (Finance): For split invoices we need PO numbers per entity and billing addresses. Net60 for POC is fine with controller approval. UK invoices must show VAT id and GBP amounts or specify currency conversion. Maria, get PO numbers and confirm if they want two PDFs or one combined invoice with lines split.

Raj (SalesOps): DocuSign plan proposal:
```
Envelope A (MSA redline): Sender -> Elaine (Legal) -> Customer GC (or delegate)
Envelope B (Orderform + PO): Sender -> Tomas (Finance) -> Customer AP
If split PO: create Envelope B1 (US) + B2 (UK) and link both to Envelope A via reference id.
```

Maria (AE): i'll ask customer for: 1) PO numbers per entity 2) subprocessors list for DPA 3) confirm primary signers + fallback. Will upload when received.

Elaine (Legal): once redline out ill review and flag any SLA/DPA clauses that require escalated approval. Action owners: Legal = Elaine, Finance = Tomas, SalesOps = Raj (for routing).

Tomas (Finance): prepping invoice templates and VAT fields. Ping me the PO numbers and whether they'd like separate wires or consolidated payments.

Maria (AE): on it, pinging customer now. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
